title: Dynamic Modeling of Microalgae Growth and Lipid Production under Transient Light and Nitrogen Conditions
description: A dynamic model of Dunaliella viridis cultivated in a lab‑scale photobioreactor under transient light and nitrogen conditions, consisting of six state‑variable ODEs coupled with light‑attenuation and nutrient functions.

model_assumptions.text: Optical cross‑section parameters a and b are taken as constant regardless of cultivation conditions.
model_assumptions.quote: a and b were independent of the cultivation conditions

model_assumptions.text: The composition of functional biomass is fixed to CH1.8O0.5N0.2.
model_assumptions.quote: functional biomass is assumed as CH_{1.8}O_{0.5}N_{0.2}

model_assumptions.text: Nitrate uptake is assumed to equal the nitrate removed from the medium.
model_assumptions.quote: algae cells assimilated the nitrate removed from the medium
